review_candidates.title: Spacecraft and Satellite Configuration Design Engineer
review_candidates.description: Backed by NASA, DARPA, and Space Force, we are a venture backed, rapidly growing startup with the ultimate goal of asteroid mining through our space platforms. The space industry is a trillion dollar market and there is so much opportunity to further explore deep space. Our world class engineering team has created patented technologies, telescopes, and capture systems that are helping us get towards achieving our ultimate goal.  Position Overview We are seeking a Spacecraft and Satellite Configuration Design Engineer to define, develop and control the physical and functional configuration of satellite platforms and payloads from formulation through delivery and mission operations. The role will lead configuration design, interface definition, mass and balance control, and integration planning while coordinating structural, thermal, electrical and RF disciplines. The engineer will own configuration baselines, support AIT and environmental test campaigns (TVAC, vibration, shock), and ensure successful launch vehicle integration and mission support. Key Responsibilities Define and maintain spacecraft and satellite configuration baselines and change control processes throughout formulation, design, AIT and operations phases. Develop, review and release detailed mechanical and electrical configuration design using CAD (Catia, NX, SolidWorks , Creo) and ensure GD&T-compliant technical drawings and Bills of Materials (BOM). Perform or coordinate mass properties, center-of-gravity and balance analyses and maintain mass budgets and margin reports. Coordinate structural and thermal analyses (NASTRAN, ANSYS), tolerance and view-factor analyses, and interpret results to drive design changes with engineering teams. Plan, write and execute environmental test plans and procedures including thermal vacuum (TVAC), vibration, shock and EMI/EMC/ESD testing; support test campaigns and hardware qualification. Lead harness and wiring design and routing, avionic integration and PCB interface reviews; manage ICDs and electrical interface control to the EPS and data systems. Develop and maintain power budgets (EPS), load analysis and power system interfaces; coordinate attitude determination and control (ADCs) and thruster interfaces where relevant. Integrate RF/communications subsystems and antennas into the spacecraft configuration; support RF performance verification and antenna deployment validation. Design, review and verify deployable mechanisms, separation systems and associated verification testing and acceptance criteria. Own AIT/Assembly integration sequencing, GSE requirements and launch vehicle integration activities; provide technical direction to AIT teams and suppliers. Manage requirements and traceability using tools such as DOORS and Jama; author and maintain interface control documents (ICDs) and configuration documentation. Perform risk analyses, including FMEA/FTA, and contribute to mitigation plans; support configuration and change impact assessments and safety reviews. Support MBSE activities with SysML/model-based engineering tools; develop CAD-to-analysis workflows and scripts (Matlab/Simulink, Python) to automate configuration and mass property updates. Provide mission operations and proximity-operations support as required, assist with anomaly investigations, and produce clear technical reports and documentation for stakeholders. Required Qualifications 3+ years of experience supporting the design, development, or integration of spacecraft, satellites, or other highly engineered aerospace systems. Proficiency with 3D CAD tools used for mechanical design and system layout of complex assemblies; experience with SolidWorks, Creo, NX, CATIA, or similar platforms. Strong understanding of multidisciplinary spacecraft integration principles, including thermal, power, communications, attitude control, structures, and propulsion considerations. Experience conducting engineering trade studies and evaluating system-level configuration options to support concept development and vehicle architecture decisions. Ability to perform preliminary engineering assessments such as mass property calculations, power evaluations, geometric analyses, and thermal accommodation studies. Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline. Familiarity with spacecraft thermal design concepts, including radiator placement, solar array accommodation, environmental impacts, and system-level thermal considerations. Understanding of communications hardware integration, including antenna placement, field-of-view requirements, and vehicle accommodation constraints. Knowledge of spacecraft electrical power hardware packaging, including batteries, solar arrays, harness routing, and volume allocation considerations. Experience creating technical visualizations, engineering drawings, configuration layouts, and presentation-ready graphics to communicate design concepts effectively. Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic engineering environment with cross-functional teams and evolving project priorities. Eligibility to work on projects subject to U.S. export control regulations. Ability to work onsite as required. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience supporting early mission concept development, architecture studies, or Phase A/B spacecraft programs. Background in spacecraft hardware development through design reviews, integration and test activities, requirements management, or operational support. Familiarity with thermal analysis methodologies and tools, including coordination with thermal engineering teams during spacecraft development. Experience with deployable systems, mechanisms, robotics, capture systems, or other moving aerospace hardware. Knowledge of launch vehicle integration constraints, payload accommodations, and mission interface requirements. Experience with mass properties tracking, configuration management, and engineering data control processes. Exposure to advanced space applications such as in-space servicing, resource utilization, orbital logistics, debris mitigation, or deep-space/cislunar missions. Active security clearance, or the ability to obtain one. Our best-in-class custodian and near-banking layer enables previously unattainable options for payments, asset management and access to products that can help enhance financial inclusion. Our infrastructure – including FDUSD, Asia’s 1st home grown blockchain-based USD stable-coin – Developed to help economies, institutions and developers gain access to technology breakthroughs and capitalize on the digital evolution of finance, trust, and technology. About us First Digital is a digital asset focused trust, custody, financial technology company at the vanguard of the emerging digitalization of assets, where the full value for your worldly assets can finally unite like other digital data. Our best-in-class custodian and near-banking layer enables previously unattainable options for payments, asset management and access to products that can help enhance financial inclusion. Our infrastructure – including FDUSD, Asia’s 1st home grown blockchain-based USD stable-coin – Developed to help economies, institutions and developers gain access to technology breakthroughs and capitalize on the digital evolution of finance, trust, and technology. Overview We are seeking an experienced IT Risk to join our dynamic team and ensure the security and resilience of our platform, with a strong focus on the risks specific to DeFi and Web3. As the IT Risk Specialist, you will have a great opportunity to work in a rapidly growing fintech company at the forefront of blockchain and Web3 innovation, an area that has drawn increasing regulatory attention around the world. This role will be central to how we manage technical and security risk as our on-chain and DeFi footprint grows. Responsibilities Identify, assess, and monitor risks specific to DeFi protocols, smart contracts, and on-chain activity, including exploits, protocol vulnerabilities, and counterparty/custody risk. Review and assess the security posture of smart contracts and blockchain infrastructure the company interacts with or builds on. Track emerging Web3 attack vectors (bridge exploits, oracle manipulation, flash loan attacks, etc.) and translate them into actionable risk controls. Actively participate in product discussions, providing risk and security input as new blockchain/DeFi features and integrations are developed. Partner with engineering and product teams to embed security-by-design principles into Web3-related builds. Develop and implement IT risk management strategies, policies, and procedures. Identify potential IT risks related to information security, data privacy, technology infrastructure, and operational processes. Conduct risk assessments and vulnerability analysis to proactively address potential threats. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote a culture of risk awareness and compliance with regulatory requirements. Monitor and assess IT security incidents, perform root cause analysis, and develop remediation plans. Stay updated on industry best practices, emerging threats, and regulatory changes to enhance the organization's IT risk framework. Oversee the implementation of security measures, encryption protocols, access controls, and disaster recovery plans. Establish incident response protocols and coordinate with external security agencies if necessary. Conduct periodic audits and reviews of IT systems, applications, and infrastructure to ensure compliance with internal and external standards. Provide risk assessment reports and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders. Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field. Proven experience (3-5 years) in technical risk, security, or DeFi/Web3-focused roles, ideally with some exposure to financial services or fintech. Strong, hands-on understanding of DeFi protocols, smart contracts, blockchain infrastructure, and associated security risks — this is core to the role. Familiarity with stablecoin services and the associated risks and challenges. Traditional IT risk / compliance experience is a plus, not a prerequisite — willingness to grow into regulatory frameworks (SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, GDPR, AML/KYC) is important. Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, or CRISC are a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented approach. Comfortable using AI tools to support research, analysis, and staying current on frameworks outside core expertise. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. The successful candidate will bring strong technical expertise, take ownership of solutions, and help establish and improve processes and standards in a growing organization. review_candidates.title: Global Payroll Accountant
review_candidates.description: About Us : Founded 20 years ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people operating throughout North America, Europe and Asia. Since spinning out of a large brokerage firm in 2016, DV Trading has rapidly scaled as an independent proprietary trading firm utilizing its own capital, trading strategies, and risk management methodologies to provide liquidity to worldwide financial markets and hedging opportunities to commodity producers and users. Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser. Overview: DV Trading is seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Global Payroll Accountant to join our London office. You'll support payroll operations across nine countries: the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates (Dubai), Spain, Poland, Denmark, Hong Kong, and Singapore. The UK is a core part of this role. London-based payroll for the UK is processed through Paycom, alongside the US and Canada. The remaining six jurisdictions are handled through TMF Group, which provides dedicated local payroll specialists in each country. You'll work closely with our US-based Global Payroll Accountant. Primary responsibilities are divided between the two roles, and you'll both build a strong understanding of our global payroll operations and provide backup coverage for each other. You'll also work with international teams and external payroll providers. Responsibilities: Process payroll for your assigned countries, validating inputs such as new hires, terminations, salary changes, bonuses, and benefits before approval. Review payroll registers and variance reports, and resolve discrepancies with Paycom, TMF Group, and internal teams. Post payroll journal entries, reconcile payroll to the general ledger, and maintain payroll balance sheet reconciliations. Coordinate with HR and Treasury on deadlines, funding, and statutory remittances. Support accruals, year-end tax documentation, and payroll-related audits. Document procedures and processing calendars and look for ways to improve controls and efficiency. Requirements: A bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. At least 3 years in payroll processing, payroll accounting, or a related role. Strong knowledge of UK payroll, including PAYE, National Insurance, and statutory requirements. Experience with payroll systems and external providers, and an understanding of payroll journal entries and reconciliations. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables and lookups. Excellent organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines. Discretion with confidential employee and financial information. Preferred: Experience coordinating payroll across multiple countries. Familiarity with Paycom, TMF Group, or similar international payroll providers. CIPP, AAT, ACCA, CIMA, or similar professional qualifications, completed or in progress. Experience working in financial services, trading, or another fast-paced industry. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics GP or comparable accounting software. Experience supporting payroll-related financial audits and statutory reporting. DV is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. Only search firms with valid, written agreements with DV should submit resumes in response to DV's posted positions. All resumes submitted by search firms to DV via e-mail, the Internet, personal delivery, facsimile, or any other method without a valid written agreement shall be deemed the sole property of DV, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by DV. DV is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

review_candidates.title: Database Engineer - Azure Based
review_candidates.description: Overview Design, build and establish a greenfield Azure-based data lakehouse platform to support business analytics, reporting, and AI/ML initiatives. This role will develop scalable data pipelines, create governed and AI-ready datasets, and partner with business and technical teams to deliver reliable insights and intelligent data solutions. Essential Duties & Responsibilities Design, build, and implement a new Azure-based data lakehouse platform to support business reporting, analytics, and AI/ML use cases. Develop and maintain scalable ETL/ELT processes for data ingestion, transformation, cleansing, enrichment, and delivery across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources. Implement lakehouse architecture patterns, including bronze/silver/gold data layers, Delta Lake table design, and curated data products for business and AI consumption. Design and optimize data models, semantic models, dimensional models, and curated datasets to support Power BI reporting, KPI tracking, business analytics, and AI training workflows. Implement and manage data storage solutions including Microsoft Fabric OneLake, Azure Data Lake Storage, relational databases, lakehouses, warehouses, and other Azure data platform services. Ensure data quality, integrity, lineage, metadata management, security, privacy, retention, and governance across all data platform components. Collaborate with business stakeholders, and operational teams to understand data requirements, validate business logic, and display data meaningfully. Collaborate with AI development team to prepare AI-ready datasets, improve data relevance, support feature engineering, and ensure training data is accurate, traceable, and appropriately governed. Configure data guardrails, access controls, classification, and filtering rules to improve AI decision making and ensure only relevant, approved, and secure data is referenced. Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve the performance, reliability, and cost efficiency of data pipelines, workflows, compute resources, and cloud data services. Automate data processes using data engineering best practices, CI/CD methods, version control, reusable pipeline patterns, documentation, and operational runbooks. Partner with business leaders and technical teams to establish data platform standards, architecture decisions, and long-term support practices for a newly implemented enterprise data environment. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Data Science/Analytics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, associated discipline, or equivalent technical experience. Minimum of 3 plus years of hands-on data engineering, database engineering, analytics engineering, or cloud data platform implementation experience. Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or significantly contributing to a new data platform, lakehouse, data warehouse, or analytics environment; greenfield implementation experience is strongly preferred. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric components including OneLake, Data Factory, Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, Data Science, Real-Time Analytics, and Power BI. Experience with Azure data services such as Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Synapse, Azure Databricks, Key Vault, RBAC, and related Azure security and governance capabilities. Hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, SQL, Python, Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, data warehousing concepts, and structured/unstructured data processing. Ability to design reliable ingestion patterns from business systems, APIs, databases, flat files, and cloud sources, including incremental loads, change data capture, validation, and error handling. Experience preparing clean, governed, documented, and repeatable datasets for AI/ML training, analytics, forecasting, decision support, or advanced automation use cases. Strong understanding of data governance, security, access controls, privacy, lineage, metadata, data quality, auditability, and responsible AI data boundaries. Experience building curated datasets, semantic models, dimensional models, star schemas, KPI definitions, and Power BI-ready data products for business users. Familiarity with DevOps practices for data platforms, including version control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, alerting, performance tuning, cost management, and production support. Strong communication skills with the ability to work directly with business stakeholders, analysts, AI developers, and technical teams to translate business needs into scalable data solutions. Preference for applicants who have worked in smaller teams or broad-ownership roles where they were responsible for architecture, implementation, stakeholder engagement, governance, and ongoing support rather than only maintaining an existing system. Headquartered in Conyers, Georgia, Batchelor & Kimball takes pride in partnering with our clients to deliver excellent results from engineering and construction to operations and maintenance. We offer design/build and turnkey construction services, including teaming with selected subcontractors for electrical and general construction. There’s not a lot of BS here, and not a lot of turnover. Good people work at Batchelor & Kimball. We’re good at our jobs, and good to each other. We have high expectations because the work is challenging, but we know the most valuable thing about the work is the people who do it. If this sounds like a good fit for you, we’d like to meet you! If you are looking to grow your career and thrive in a team environment, then we invite you to apply for this position.
